items.title: Witch Spinning Moonlit Wool
items.alt: A seated witch spins pale wool on a wooden spinning wheel.
items.description: A patient witch sits beside a small spinning wheel with a simple connected treadle and holds a soft strand of pale wool. Use this illustration for fiber craft journals and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch with a Moon Weather Vane
items.alt: A witch tightens the base of a crescent weather vane with a small wrench.
items.description: A witch holds a miniature crescent weather vane upright while tightening its base with a small wrench, no letters or compass labels. Use this illustration for making and repairing stories and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch Tying a Bottle Label
items.alt: A witch ties a blank oval tag around a stoppered potion bottle.
items.description: A witch ties a completely blank oval paper tag around one stoppered potion bottle, with a short twine spool beside her. Use this illustration for gift-tag activity sheets and personal crafts.
